verified_facts.text: Vdara is a casino-free, smoke-free spa resort on the Las Vegas Strip.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vdara delivers a relaxing and unique take on Las Vegas vacations as a casino-free, smoke-free spa resort situated on the strip.

verified_facts.text: Vdara sits in the CityCenter complex between Bellagio and Aria, set slightly back from Las Vegas Boulevard, with walkway connections to both.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the CityCenter complex between Bellagio and Aria, set slightly back from

verified_facts.text: Every room at Vdara is a suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room at Vdara is a suite, which changes the whole feel of a stay here.

verified_facts.text: Standard studios come with a sitting area, dining table, and kitchenette with a cooktop, microwave, sink and refrigerator.
verified_facts.excerpt: come with a sitting area, dining table, and kitchenette equipped with a cooktop, microwave, sink, and empty refrigerator you can actually stock yourself

verified_facts.text: Larger suite categories add full kitchens and often in-suite washer-dryers.
verified_facts.excerpt: add more square footage, full kitchens, and often in-suite washer–dryer setups that make longer trips or work stays much easier

verified_facts.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of the mountains, CityCenter, or, in fountain view layouts, the Bellagio Fountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of the mountains, CityCenter, or, in specific “fountain view” layouts, the Bellagio Fountains across the way.

verified_facts.text: The rooms' look is modern and somewhat understated, more sleek condo than themed resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: The overall look is modern and somewhat understated—more sleek condo than themed resort

verified_facts.text: Vdara Pool & Cabanas offers cabanas with semi-secluded plunge pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by cutting-edge design, private retreats and cabanas with semi-secluded plunge pools, Vdara Pool & Cabanas offers blissful escape.

verified_facts.text: The pool deck is significantly more relaxed than the party scenes at many nearby properties, with no DJ-driven dayclub.
verified_facts.excerpt: significantly more relaxed than the party scenes at many nearby properties, with cabanas and semi-private plunge areas rather than a DJ-driven dayclub

verified_facts.text: The Spa at Vdara is spread across two floors with European-style heat experiences, quiet relaxation areas and ESPA-branded treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: spread across two floors with European-style heat experiences, quiet relaxation areas, and ESPA-branded treatments

verified_facts.text: The naturally lit Fitness Center has cardio equipment with personal entertainment centers, weight machines and free weights.
verified_facts.excerpt: Make yourself comfortable in our naturally lit Fitness Center, featuring a variety of state-of-the-art cardio equipment, each outfitted with personal entertainment centers, as well as weight machines, free weights

verified_facts.text: Market Café Vdara handles quick breakfasts, salads, sandwiches and grab-and-go meals, plus groceries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Market Café Vdara handles quick breakfasts, salads, sandwiches, and grab-and-go meals, plus groceries and frozen items you can heat up in your kitchenette

verified_facts.text: VICE VERSA Patio & Lounge is the main bar and social space, with indoor-outdoor seating.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vice Versa Patio & Lounge functions as the main bar and social space, with indoor-outdoor seating

verified_facts.text: Pedestrian paths and interior walkways connect Vdara to Aria, Bellagio and the larger CityCenter complex, including the Shops at Crystals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pedestrian paths and interior walkways connect you to Aria’s casino and restaurants, Bellagio’s casino and fountains, and the larger CityCenter complex, including the Shops at Crystals.

verified_facts.text: T-Mobile Arena and Park MGM are an easy walk from Vdara.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is an easy walk to T-Mobile Arena and Park MGM for concerts and games

verified_facts.text: Vdara opened in 2009 as part of CityCenter, conceived as a condo-hotel hybrid.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vdara opened in 2009 as part of CityCenter, conceived from the start as a condo-hotel hybrid

verified_facts.text: Vdara works well for longer stays and families who value space and kitchenettes, though there is no dedicated kid zone.
verified_facts.excerpt: Works well for longer stays and families who value space and kitchenettes, though there is no dedicated kid zone

verified_facts.text: Vdara is part of MGM Rewards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Part of MGM Rewards through its connection with Aria and CityCenter

verified_facts.text: The Executive Corner Suite offers 811 square feet of space.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Executive Corner Suite offers 811 square feet of space for you to enjoy.
